test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given below, followed by four conclusions given in the options. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statement.

Statement: A ≥ C > D = B ≤ F > G
solution: Given Statement: A ≥ C > D = B ≤ F > G Now, Conclusions: Option 1: C = G → False (C > D = B ≤ F > G No relation can be established between C and G)
